final: WITH base AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.healtheval AS status, s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin AS ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), grp AS (SELECT site_code, status, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM base GROUP BY site_code, status), mean_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.m AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN mean_avg m WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.m ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
